text_block_list.text:
On a day off, I went to the shopping 
street and found it buzzing with 
preparations for some kind of event. Among 
the crowd, there was Neo Universe—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
What will be held on this ground today... 
is a "festival".

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
...The "Soybean Planetary Alignment 
Festival". A grand celebration of 
soybeans, gathering all kinds of soybean 
products.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Today... I want to universally 
"perceive"... the "EXIN" of light emitted 
by the soybeans.

text_block_list.name: Angry Man's Voice A
text_block_list.text:
—What's that, you wanna go?! You 
fragile-ass Tofu Faction punks!

text_block_list.name: Angry Man's Voice B
text_block_list.text:
What did you say?! You rotten Natto Party 
bastards!!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: ..."TRBL"?

text_block_list.name: Natto Faction Man
text_block_list.text:
This is a festival dedicated to the 
Soybean God! Naturally, here at the center 
of the event, we should erect a Natto 
statue, the absolute pinnacle of soybean 
products!

text_block_list.name: Tofu Faction Man
text_block_list.text:
Nonsense! Tofu is the true representative 
of soybean products! Therefore, we should 
erect a Tofu statue!

text_block_list.name: Bean Sprout Faction Old Woman
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear, a conflict between the two giants 
of the soybean world...! At this rate, the 
event itself will be ruined...!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
...At this rate, a Giant Impact. I will... 
intervene in the "collision".

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Natto" and "Tofu"... Though their 
"origin" is the same, their properties are 
separated by the "Menelaus Valley"... A 
"rendezvous" might be difficult.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Neo Universe wishes for it. "Dialogue"... 
"AMRT". Therefore—

text_block_list.name: Natto Faction Man
text_block_list.text:
...Hmph, I've got no clue what you're 
babbling about! I can't grasp the point at 
all! Just like the bland taste of tofu!

text_block_list.name: Tofu Faction Man
text_block_list.text:
Stay out of this! Stop clinging to us like 
sticky natto...!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
choice_data_list: ...What on earth should we do about this?
...What can we even do about this?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
............ ...Neo Universe will produce 
"proof".

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Transmission", requested...! 
"Connection"...! "Interference"...!

text_block_list.name: Natto Faction Man
text_block_list.text:
What is it, missy?! You're being as 
persistent and sticky as natto!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
..."Exchange"! "Bond"...! 
"Understanding"...! "Heart"...!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
...The "signals" of you two haven't cut 
out. So... you should be able to 
"connect".

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Transmit" and "receive". That will create 
a "miracle".

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: The "origin point" is... this.

With that, Neo Universe took soybeans out 
of a bag and handed them to the two men.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Please try... "eating".

text_block_list.name: Natto Faction Man
text_block_list.text:
............! T-This is...! Even though 
it's raw soybean before being fermented 
into natto— it has a gentle warmth, like 
being softly wrapped in strings!

text_block_list.name: Tofu Faction Man
text_block_list.text:
Even though it's raw soybean before being 
ground—I can feel the tofu. This is... the 
taste of the "origin"!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
...Now... you should be able to 
"receive"... each other's "signal". You 
should be able to "hear" it.

text_block_list.name: Natto Faction Man
text_block_list.text:
...I see. All along, we... shared the 
exact same origin...

text_block_list.name: Tofu Faction Man
text_block_list.text:
Let us let bygones be water under the 
bridge. Smooth and silky, just like tofu—

text_block_list.name: Bean Sprout Faction Old Woman
text_block_list.text:
Ohh... It's a miracle! It's all thanks to 
you, dear...!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: ...Connections are important.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Because the connection of "feelings"... is 
what causes miracles to "EXIN".

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Neo Universe will continue... to "prove" 
that "providence".

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Now... "intervening" in the festival. I 
will intake "soybean dishes"... 
universally.

And so, the event was held without a 
hitch, and Neo Universe thoroughly 
relished all kinds of soybean delicacies.
